newsitem.title: CANADA: Atlantis shrs jump sharply on light volume.
newsitem.headline: Atlantis shrs jump sharply on light volume.

text.p: Atlantis Communications Inc shares jumped sharply on light volume on Thursday after two announcements this week about the company's upcoming productions.

Shares of the Toronto-based television producer were up 0.65 to 8.75 in late afternoon trading of more than 2,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange. The shares traded as high as 9.95 earlier in the session.

"The company has had ongoing favorable news. The outlook is good. It's not surpising that the stock is increasing even though the markets are poor," said Roger Dent, an entertainment analyst with Yorkton Securities Inc. Dent has a buy rating on the stock.
But he added that "the volume on the stock has been very light. I don't know if I would necessarily attach a huge importance to today's trading."

Atlantis said on Wednesday that CanWest Global Communications Inc and the government-owned Canadian Broadcasting Corp agreed to share broadcast rights to "Traders", an Atlantis-produced drama about a Toronto brokerage. "Traders" was previously broadcast only by CanWest.

On Monday, Atlantis said worldwide video rights and TV rights for most parts of the world outside North America were sold to PolyGram Filmed Entertainment for Gene Roddenberry's "Battleground Earth". The series is also produced by Atlantis.
